title: Active-Order Hierarchy with Soft Delete
description_html:
Manage a hierarchy of entities with one root. Each entity may have children, ordered by the time they were added (earlier children first). Entities can become inactive, but stay in the hierarchy because their children may still be active.

Implement:

  • addChild(parentId, childId)
  • markInactive(entityId)
  • getActiveOrder() — all active entities in hierarchy order: start at the root, visit an entity before its children, visit children oldest→newest, and skip inactive entities themselves but still traverse their children.

Example

addChild(root, A); addChild(root, B); addChild(B, C); addChild(B, D)
markInactive(B)
getActiveOrder() -> [root, A, C, D]   # B skipped, its children C,D still listed

Pre-order traversal where the active check gates EMISSION, not recursion. See Notes.
